text: Figure 4.14: Modeling overview on signature support for an IdsmInstance Depending on whether the IdsmInstance is deployed on the Classic or the Adaptive Platform, either IdsmSignatureSupportCp or IdsmSignatureSupportAp shall be used for configuration of signature calculation. [TPS_SECXT_01032] Semantics of IdsmSignatureSupportCp Status: DRAFT ⌈For the Classic Platform, IdsmSignatureSupportCp represents the configuration of signature support for the aggregating IdsmInstance: • The reference in the role authentication to CryptoServicePrimitive de- fines the cryptographic algorithm to be used. • The reference in the role cryptoServiceKey to CryptoServiceKey defines the cryptographic key to be used. ⌋ [TPS_SECXT_01033] Semantics of IdsmSignatureSupportAp Status: DRAFT ⌈For the Adaptive Platform, IdsmSignatureSupportAp represents the configuration of signature support for the aggregating IdsmInstance: • The attribute cryptoPrimitive defines the cryptographic algorithm to be used as specified by the Cryptographic Primitives Naming Convention in [9]. emplate
